    # 这类星球的区划按「层级」归类，与槽位序号无关，所以这里按槽的产出族取目标，
    # 而不是写死 z3->d1 / z4->d2 / z5->d3（旧写法会把能量槽按矿物族的目标抬起来）。

                        which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z3
                        value > 0
                    }
                }
                check_variable_arithmetic = {
                    which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z3
                    value < value:bca_adv_zone_energy_next

                    value < value:bca_adv_zone_minerals_next
                }
            }
            set_variable = {
                which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z5
                value = value:bca_adv_zone_minerals_next
            }
        }
        # z5 槽 = food 族
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z5_food
                bca_empire_needs_food = yes
                # 方案为 0 视为玩家明确不要建，不动。
                OR = {
                    NOT = { is_variable_set = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z5 }
                    check_variable = {
                        which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z5
                        value > 0
                    }
                }
                check_variable_arithmetic = {
                    which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z5
                    value < value:bca_adv_food_next
                }
            }
            set_variable = {
                which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z5
                value = value:bca_adv_food_next
            }
        }
    }

    # 2026-11-21：科研 / 统一 / 行政类星球不让次级区划抢格子。
    # 这些星球的产出靠「特区槽 + 建筑」，次级区划（发电/采矿/农业）只吃区划位、不产研究/凝聚。
    # 这里把三个方案统一压回「该族已建数量」：只停止新建，不触发拆除（拆除条件是 方案 < 已建）。
    # 玩家仍然可以用 +/- 手动设定；锁定槽由后面的还原逻辑保护。
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                has_research_designation = yes
                has_unity_designation = yes
            }
        }
        set_variable = { which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z3 value = value:num_district_d1 }
        set_variable = { which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z4 value = value:num_district_d2 }
        set_variable = { which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z5 value = value:num_district_d3 }
    }

# 还原手动方案（放在所有自动规划之后，手动锁定的槽以玩家数字为准，不再被抬高）。
    # 未锁定的槽：自动规划已按缺口写好目标，这里不动它。
    if = {
        limit = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_manual_count_z3 }
        set_variable = {
            which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z3
            value = bca_ps_manual_saved_count_z3
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_manual_count_z4 }
        set_variable = {
            which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z4
            value = bca_ps_manual_saved_count_z4
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_manual_count_z5 }
        set_variable = {
            which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z5
            value = bca_ps_manual_saved_count_z5
        }
    }
    # 方案总和不能超过「星球容量 - 1」：超出时把溢出的部分从 z3 方案里扣掉，
    # 避免三个槽位都满额导致城市方案被压到下限、后续拆建来回震荡。
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable_arithmetic = {
                which = value:bca_num_free_secondary_districts_plan_full_secondary_districts
                value < 0
            }
        }
        add_variable = {
            which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z3
            value = value:bca_num_free_secondary_districts_plan_full_secondary_districts
        }
    }
    # 2026-11-15 修复：方案总量必须落在「当前空余区划槽 - 1」以内（至少给城市留 1 个槽）。
    # 预建造星旗 bca_pf_planet_pre_construction 会让 bca_planet_build_needs_* 全部为真，
    # 方案会被直接写到各族上限；若星球其实只剩 0~1 个空槽，就会出现「计划 10 个、只建得动 1 个」，
    # 自动化每月举牌却永远建不出来，还会让城市方案被挤掉、失业人口没人管。
    # 收敛下限是该族已建数量（num_district_d1/d2/d3），保证不会低于现状而触发拆除。
    while = {
        limit = {
            check_variable_arithmetic = {
                which = value:bca_num_free_districts_for_secondary_plan_reserved
                value < 0
            }
            OR = {
                AND = {
                    NOT = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_manual_count_z4 }
                    check_variable_arithmetic = {
                        which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z4
                        value > value:num_district_d2
                    }
                }
                AND = {
                    NOT = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_manual_count_z3 }
                    check_variable_arithmetic = {
                        which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z3
                        value > value:num_district_d1
                    }
                }
                AND = {
                    NOT = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_manual_count_z5 }
                    check_variable_arithmetic = {
                        which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z5
                        value > value:num_district_d3
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_manual_count_z4 }
                check_variable_arithmetic = {
                    which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z4
                    value > value:num_district_d2
                }
            }
            subtract_variable = {
                which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z4
                value = 1
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_manual_count_z3 }
                check_variable_arithmetic = {
                    which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z3
                    value > value:num_district_d1
                }
            }
            subtract_variable = {
                which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z3
                value = 1
            }
        }
        else = {
            subtract_variable = {
                which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z5
                value = 1
            }
        }
    }
    # 方案钳制（2026-10-20 玩家反馈：栖息地副区划方案出现负数 -11）：方案变量不允许低于 0，防止拆建循环与城市方案膨胀
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = { which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z3 value < 0 }
        }
        set_variable = {
            which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z3
            value = 0
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = { which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z4 value < 0 }
        }
        set_variable = {
            which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z4
            value = 0
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = { which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z5 value < 0 }
        }
        set_variable = {
            which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z5
            value = 0
        }
    }
    # ===== 收口：锁定槽的唯一写入者 =====
    # 无论前面多少块写过 plan，锁定槽最终一律恢复成玩家数字；
    # 这样"锁定"在语义上等于"自动逻辑对该槽不存在"，不会互相覆盖。
    if = {
        limit = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_manual_count_z3 }
        set_variable = {
            which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z3
            value = bca_ps_manual_saved_count_z3
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_manual_count_z4 }
        set_variable = {
            which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z4
            value = bca_ps_manual_saved_count_z4
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_manual_count_z5 }
        set_variable = {
            which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z5
            value = bca_ps_manual_saved_count_z5
        }
    }

}
